ordered_replies.visible_body_text: Correction: our 04:16 ET EUR/USD and 04:18 ET US crude oil updates said price had reached the entry zone. It had not: at those times both plans were still waiting for price to reach their zones, EUR/USD 1.1166–1.117 and US crude oil 90.2–90.45. Analysis, not financial advice. Capital Chronicle may hold positions in the markets it covers.
